import sys
import io
import pathlib

import pytest
from target import get_write_function


def test_none_output_writes_to_stderr(capsys):
    write = get_write_function(None)
    write("stderr message")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.err == "stderr message"


def test_path_string_output_writes_to_file(tmp_path):
    file_path = tmp_path / "output.txt"
    write = get_write_function(str(file_path))
    write("file content")
    assert file_path.read_text() == "file content"


def test_pathlib_path_output_writes_to_file(tmp_path):
    file_path = tmp_path / "output2.txt"
    write = get_write_function(file_path)  # pathlib.Path instance
    write("another content")
    assert file_path.read_text() == "another content"


def test_writable_stream_output():
    stream = io.StringIO()
    write = get_write_function(stream)
    write("stream data")
    assert stream.getvalue() == "stream data"
